description: This file contains helper functions for health check calls in a machine learning/AI project, including model selection, request metadata updates, and mode handler definitions for different health check modes.

classes.name: HealthCheckHelpers
classes.description: A class providing static methods for health check operations, including model selection, request metadata updates, and mode handler retrieval.

methods.name: ahealth_check_wildcard_models
methods.description: Performs a health check on wildcard models by selecting models from a provider and executing an async completion call.

methods.name: _update_model_params_with_health_check_tracking_information
methods.description: Updates model parameters with tracking metadata and user API key authentication info for health check requests.

methods.name: _get_metadata_for_health_check_call
methods.description: Returns metadata tags for health check calls, including a specific internal health service account name.

methods.name: get_mode_handlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of mode handler functions for different health check modes such as chat, completion, embedding, audio, image, video, rerank, realtime, batch, responses, and OCR.
